story.fullStory:
Rick Astley's "Never Gonna Give You Up" reached #1 on the Billboard Hot 100. "Never Gonna Give You Up" is a pop song by English singer Rick Astley, released on 27 July 1987.

The song is widely regarded as Astley's most popular, as well as his signature song, and it is often played at the end of his live concerts.

Written and produced by Stock Aitken Waterman, it was released by RCA Records as the first single from Astley's debut studio album, Whenever You Need Somebody (1987), with a music video directed by Simon West.

The song peaked at #1 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 24 weeks on the chart.

Whenever You Need Somebody is the debut studio album by English singer Rick Astley, released on 16 November 1987 by RCA Records.
